Edge integrity where thin wing edges meet complex green background.
Anatomical correctness of the antenna clubs and body segmentation.

Verify that the 'fuzziness' of the body looks like natural hair/setae rather than smudged noise. Check if the depth of field blur is consistent with a macro lens (sharp subject, smooth bokeh) or if there are warping artifacts in the background leaves near the subject boundaries.
